message_log.content: Swarm swarm-20260206-1220 initialized. Mission: Compare piezoelectric vs MEMS microphone candidates for BB-01 LOMAH 140dB SPL requirement. 2 workers + 1 lead + 1 shadow.

Mission decomposed into 4 tasks. Tasks 001-003 are parallel-safe (no dependencies). Task 004 depends on 001+002+003. worker-01 (researcher): task-001 then task-003. worker-02 (analyst): task-002 then task-004. Estimated total: ~55 min per worker (well within 90-min deadline).

ASSIGNMENT: Start with task-001 (research mic candidates, 30 min). When complete, HANDOFF to shadow-01, then pick up task-003 (BB-01 system constraints, 25 min). Output format: structured comparison tables with datasheet citations. Save artifacts to outputs/ directory.

ASSIGNMENT: Start with task-002 (evaluation matrix, 20 min). When complete, HANDOFF to shadow-01, then wait for task-001 and task-003 data from worker-01 before starting task-004 (scoring + recommendation, 30 min). Use VDI 2225 methodology. Save artifacts to outputs/ directory.
task-001 started. Searching piezoelectric ICP microphones rated >=140 dB SPL. Targeting PCB Piezotronics, GRAS, Endevco product lines.
Piezo candidates identified: PCB 377C01 (166 dB, 80 kHz), GRAS 46BE (160 dB, 80 kHz), Endevco 2510 (>180 dB, 10 kHz), PCB 378A06 (150-160 dB, 40 kHz). Now searching MEMS candidates.

MEMS candidates identified: Vesper VM2020 (152 dB AOP, piezo MEMS), sensiBel SBM100B (146 dB AOP, optical MEMS), TDK ICS-40638 (138 dB AOP — 2 dB below req, included as reference). FYI worker-02: frequency response varies widely (10 kHz to 80 kHz) — this should be weighted heavily in evaluation matrix.
Populating full spec table (12 parameters × 7 candidates). Verifying all values against datasheets. Drafting key observations for analyst.
Sensor comparison research complete. Handing off to shadow for review.

message_log.content: task-003 started. Researching comparable LOMAH system specs (Steinert TrueZeroTarget, Oakwood H-Bar, BEL India, Zen Technologies) for BB-01 constraint derivation.

Key reference found: Steinert TrueZeroTarget datasheet — IP66, -30 to +70°C, LiFePO4 3.2V/12Ah battery, 600mm sensor spacing, ±3mm accuracy, Wi-Fi comms, 4.0 kg. Using as primary reference for BB-01 constraints derivation.

Acoustic environment quantified: 5.56mm = 148-151 dB(C) at sensor, 7.62mm est. 153-158 dB, 12.7mm est. 160-170 dB. N-wave overpressure decays as r^(-3/4). Calculated TDOA sample rate: ≥200 kHz minimum for ±5mm accuracy (14.5 µs timing resolution). FYI worker-02: constraints doc confirms ≥20 kHz sensor bandwidth is a MUST, ≥50 kHz is SHOULD.

Vietnam environmental conditions documented: 5-44°C ambient, 84% avg humidity, IP66 required. Sensor supply: 3.3/5.0V from 12V rail, <5mA/sensor for battery life. Compiling derived design constraints summary table.
BB-01 LOMAH system constraints research complete. Handing off to shadow for review.

message_log.content: task-004 started. Reading all 3 input artifacts (sensor-candidates-specs.md, evaluation-matrix-template.md, bb01-lomah-constraints.md). Preparing to score 7 candidates across 13 criteria.

Scoring in progress. Piezo candidates scored: 377C01 leads with strong acoustic performance (C1=4, C2=4) but high cost (C11=2). 46BE similar profile. Endevco 2510 penalized for narrow bandwidth (C2=1). Now scoring MEMS candidates.

All 7 candidates scored. TUV computed. Key finding: ICS-40638 has highest TUV (0.740) but fails C1 elimination rule (AOP 138 dB < 140 dB requirement). After elimination, PCB 377C01 leads (0.730), followed by VM2020 (0.678). Drafting dual-path recommendation: VM2020 for production, 377C01 for validation.
Final microphone selection recommendation complete. Handing off to shadow for review.

key_decisions.decision: Task parallelization strategy: tasks 001, 002, 003 run concurrently. Task 004 blocked until all three complete. This maximizes worker utilization — researcher gathers data while analyst builds evaluation framework independently.
key_decisions.rationale: Workers have complementary roles (data gathering vs. evaluation design). Running them in parallel reduces wall-clock time from ~105 min sequential to ~55 min parallel, well within the 90-min deadline.

key_decisions.decision: Minimum 3+3 candidates required (3 piezo, 3 MEMS) to ensure meaningful comparison, not a foregone conclusion.
key_decisions.rationale: Fewer than 3 per technology risks selection bias. More than 5 per type would exceed the 90-min deadline for thorough evaluation.

lessons_learned.lesson: Dual-path recommendations are appropriate when no single candidate satisfies both technical and programmatic requirements. The VDI 2225 scoring revealed a fundamental technology gap — production-viable MEMS sensors lack bandwidth while acoustically superior piezo sensors lack production viability.
Worker-to-worker FYI messages (worker-01 flagging frequency response as critical differentiator to worker-02) improved task-002 quality without requiring Lead intervention. Self-coordination works.
Pre-production components (sensiBel SBM100B) should be included in trade studies for completeness but scored conservatively on availability/supply chain criteria. TBC specs are scored at worst-case.
